title: McKinsey technology trends outlook 2026
notes: Sixth edition, 143-page PDF, published 2026-09-15 (datePublished on the web page). The PDF is not in the Wayback Machine and mckinsey.com refuses scripted and WebFetch access, so only the web article (Wayback snapshot 2026-09-15) was read. It names all 14 trends and three groups (AI revolution, compute and connectivity frontiers, cutting-edge engineering) but not the printed order or the group of each trend, and gives no per-trend investment, job-posting or adoption figures. rank is null throughout; trend entries follow the order of the page's exhibit description. Forecast entries are from the page's own text.

entries.label: Equity investment across trends
entries.quote: Five of the trends—agentic software development, AI infrastructure and model architectures, AI for scientific discovery and engineering, the future of space technologies, and the future of robotics—are on track to receive more than double the investment in 2026 compared with 2025

entries.note: Extrapolated by the publisher from first-half 2026 investment. Applies to each of the five trends named.

entries.subject: Equity investment across trends
entries.note: Extrapolated from first-half 2026. Implies 13 of 14 trends up year over year in 2026.
